note: WVF-KR-V1 baseline (STEP 2). Williams Vix Fix (Larry Williams, Active Trader Dec 2007) original formula: WVF = (Highest(Close,22) - Low) / Highest(Close,22) * 100. Entry on WVF crossing above Bollinger Band(20,2.0) upper band; Exit on WVF crossing below BB midline (20 SMA). Long only, no pyramiding, no leverage. Dynamic mean-reversion exit NOT expressible in engine.executor's fixed STOP/TARGET/TIME contract, so driver-driven exactly like MACD/Squeeze/SuperTrend: engine DATA layer (A2aProvider/UniverseProvider/calendar/_drop_suspension_rows), engine PORTFOLIO accounting (engine.portfolio.Portfolio), CostModel, engine.metrics - not engine.executor.simulate_trade.

signal.entry: WVF crosses above BB upper band (WVF[t] >= BB_upper[t] AND WVF[t-1] < BB_upper[t-1])
signal.exit: WVF crosses below BB midline (WVF[t] < BB_mid[t] AND WVF[t-1] >= BB_mid[t-1])

exit.note: Mean reversion exit (BB midline cross) is a dynamic (state-machine) exit, NOT a static stop/target/time. Implemented in the research driver, not engine.executor.

pit.rule: no signal on/before ticker's A1a listedAt. Gateway applied at the signal date t: t < listedAt -> signal discarded. Entry is at next_session(t) so it is necessarily after listedAt.

period.note: Indicator warm-up uses pre-2016 bars; only trades with signal_date >= performanceStart are generated/measured.
